raw.query: WITH current_runs AS (SELECT run_id, experiment, window_name, is_current, superseded_by, source_path FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true), class_stats AS (SELECT e.run_id, e.class_name, e.requests, e.request_share, SUM(e.requests) OVER (PARTITION BY e.run_id) AS denominator_requests FROM provenance.eda_request_class e JOIN current_runs d ON d.run_id = e.run_id) SELECT s.run_id, d.experiment, d.window_name, d.is_current, d.superseded_by, d.source_path, s.class_name, s.requests, s.denominator_requests, s.request_share, 100.0 * s.requests / s.denominator_requests AS computed_percent, ROUND((100.0 * s.requests / s.denominator_requests)::numeric, 1) AS percent_rounded_1dp FROM class_stats s JOIN current_runs d ON d.run_id = s.run_id ORDER BY s.run_id, s.class_name
raw.evidence: The current, non-superseded fulltrace run reports 500017 text requests out of 1000000; 50.0% is valid only after one-decimal rounding, not as an exact value.
